name: Caustic
author: Erin Carter
description: The pool-bottom light net: two jittered Voronoi cell layers multiply into a sharp filament web with hot knots where lines cross, on near-black ground. The layers shear and each cell's jitter point orbits slowly, so the net fattens, thins and rewires continuously while the four palette colours read as regional tints.

params.label: Shear speed
params.effect: Relative drift rate between the two cell layers — how fast the light net rewires itself.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: CSS-pixel size of the web's cells, from a fine dense mesh to a few large open loops.

params.label: Filament sharpness
params.effect: Sharpness exponent on the ridge falloff — high gives crisp hairline filaments, low gives fat soft strands of light.
